data.cde_name: Adverse event during study indicator
data.cde_definition: Indicator of whether the participant/subject experienced any adverse events during the study

data.cde_definition: Date (and time, if applicable and known) on which the adverse event discontinued/stopped

data.cde_name: Adverse event outcome status
data.cde_definition: Final status of the participant/subject related to the adverse event

data.cde_name: Adverse event relatedness scale
data.cde_definition: Scale of the causality between the treatment modality/intervention and the specific adverse event

data.cde_name: Adverse event severity grade scale
data.cde_definition: The grading scale of the severity or intensity of the adverse event

data.cde_name: Patient Health Questionnaire 9 item (PHQ-9) total score [Reported]
data.cde_definition: The PHQ-9 is the standard (and most commonly used) depression measure, and it ranges from 0-27 Scoring: Add up all checked boxes on PHQ-9. For every check: Not at all = 0; Several days = 1; More than half the days = 2; Nearly every day = 3 (the scores are the codes that appear in the answer list for each of the PHQ-9 problem panel terms). Interpretation: 1-4 = Minimal depression; 5-9 = Mild depression; 10-14 = Moderate depression; 15-19 = Moderately severe depression; 20-27 = Severed depression.
